description: This Java source file defines the ContentSearchSession class, which manages content search options, constraints, and session-based search state within the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for search options, methods for processing search parameters, and session management utilities.

classes.name: ContentSearchSession
classes.description: Utility class for managing content search options and session state within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ContentSearchOptions
classes.description: Serializable class encapsulating search constraints, sort order, view index, and size, with methods to manipulate and retrieve search options from session.

methods.name: getContentSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the current ContentSearchOptions object stored in the session.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes search parameters from a request, updating session search options accordingly, including constraints, sort order, and view settings.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a search constraint to the session's current search options.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the current search session.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the history list of search options stored in the session.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of human-readable constraint descriptions for display.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current sort order.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Saves the current search options to history if they have changed.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a constraint at a specified index from the current search options.
